column1: # Why EDP must be averaged per-width, not computed from averaged switches/delay.
# 'Correct' = mean(switches_w * delay_w) across all 7 widths (2..64-bit), i.e. mean of the
# per-width EDP values already in monte_carlo_results_sta.csv.
# 'Naive (wrong)' = mean(switches across widths) * mean(delay across widths) -- invalid
# whenever switches and delay are correlated across widths (true for RCA/CLA, both grow
# with N; NOT true for SD, whose delay is a flat 4ns at every width, hence 0% error there).
